Metadata.title: PT Java Export | Premium Agricultural & Maritime Export
Metadata.description: Direct export of seafood, highland coffee, coconut derivatives and fresh produce from Southern East Java, Indonesia.

Hero.title: Indonesia's Premium Agricultural & Maritime Exporter
Hero.description: Connecting world buyers directly with sustainably harvested seafood, highland coffee, coconut derivatives, and fresh produce from the fertile Southern Java corridor.

coldChain.title: Cold-Chain Logistics Integrated
coldChain.description: Equipped with temperature-controlled reefer containers (–25°C to +15°C) from harvest origins in Sendangbiru & Prigi straight to Tanjung Perak Port, Surabaya.

fairTrade.title: Direct Farmer & Fishermen Fair-Trade
fairTrade.description: Partnering with over 85 local cooperatives across Malang, Blitar, Tulungagung, Trenggalek, Pacitan, and Banyuwangi to guarantee trace-to-source quality.
